change: Malaysia denounces ILO C105 (abolition of forced labor).
change_id: Malaysia menarik diri dari ILO C105 (penghapusan kerja paksa).

change: Thailand signs employment memoranda with Cambodia and Myanmar (Laos 2002), the basis of the MOU recruitment system.
change_id: Thailand menandatangani nota kesepahaman ketenagakerjaan dengan Kamboja dan Myanmar (Laos 2002), dasar sistem rekrutmen MOU.

change: ASEAN leaders adopt the Cebu Declaration on the rights of migrant workers.
change_id: Para pemimpin ASEAN mengadopsi Deklarasi Cebu tentang hak pekerja migran.

change: Weekly rest day for migrant domestic workers (compensation in lieu allowed).
change_id: Hari istirahat mingguan bagi PRT migran (boleh diganti kompensasi).

change: Minimum wage extended to foreign workers.
change_id: Upah minimum diperluas ke pekerja asing.

change: Ministerial regulations on labor protection in agricultural work and in sea fishing work.
change_id: Peraturan menteri tentang perlindungan tenaga kerja di pertanian dan perikanan laut.

change: EU issues a 'yellow card' to Thailand over illegal fishing; labor reforms in fisheries follow.
change_id: UE memberi 'kartu kuning' kepada Thailand terkait penangkapan ikan ilegal; reformasi ketenagakerjaan perikanan menyusul.

change: ASEAN Convention against Trafficking in Persons adopted (in force March 2017).
change_id: Konvensi ASEAN Menentang Perdagangan Orang diadopsi (berlaku Maret 2017).

change: Royal Ordinance on the Management of Employment of Foreign Workers, amended in 2018 after protests over penalties.
change_id: Royal Ordinance tentang Pengelolaan Ketenagakerjaan Pekerja Asing, diubah pada 2018 setelah protes atas sanksinya.

change: ASEAN Consensus on the Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Migrant Workers signed in Manila.
change_id: Konsensus ASEAN tentang Pelindungan dan Pemajuan Hak Pekerja Migran ditandatangani di Manila.

change: Thailand ratifies the ILO forced labor protocol (P29).
change_id: Thailand meratifikasi protokol kerja paksa ILO (P29).

change: Thailand ratifies ILO C188 (work in fishing); the EU lifts the yellow card the same month.
change_id: Thailand meratifikasi ILO C188 (kerja di perikanan); UE mencabut kartu kuning pada bulan yang sama.

change: Foreign workers enter the national employment injury scheme (PERKESO).
change_id: Pekerja asing masuk skema jaminan kecelakaan kerja nasional (PERKESO).

change: Work in Fishing Act B.E. 2562 implements C188.
change_id: UU Kerja di Perikanan B.E. 2562 melaksanakan C188.

change: Domestic workers, including foreign ones, enter the PERKESO employment injury scheme.
change_id: PRT, termasuk yang asing, masuk skema jaminan kecelakaan kerja PERKESO.

change: Malaysia ratifies the ILO forced labor protocol (P29).
change_id: Malaysia meratifikasi protokol kerja paksa ILO (P29).

change: Malaysia–Indonesia MOU on domestic workers (One Channel System).
change_id: Nota kesepahaman Malaysia–Indonesia tentang PRT (Sistem Satu Kanal).

change: Employment Act amendments in force: 45-hour week, forced labor offence, approval to employ foreign workers.
change_id: Perubahan Akta Kerja berlaku: 45 jam seminggu, tindak pidana kerja paksa, persetujuan untuk mempekerjakan pekerja asing.

change: One rest day a month for migrant domestic workers can no longer be compensated in lieu.
change_id: Satu hari istirahat sebulan bagi PRT migran tidak lagi boleh diganti kompensasi.

change: ASEAN declarations on migrant fishers and on migrant workers in crisis situations.
change_id: Deklarasi ASEAN tentang nelayan migran dan pekerja migran dalam situasi krisis.

change: Brunei's first Minimum Wage Order, limited to two sectors.
change_id: Perintah Upah Minimum pertama Brunei, terbatas pada dua sektor.

change: Minimum wage raised to RM1,700 a month.
change_id: Upah minimum dinaikkan menjadi RM1.700 sebulan.
